content: Mehlahn Mahn akan
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Moses, “Kohwei rehn Parao oh ndaiong me KAUN-O, Koht en mehn Ipru kan, mahsanih, “Komw mweidala pwe nei aramas akan en patolahng kaudokiong ie.
Ma komw sohte pahn pwurehng kupwurki re en patopatohla,
I pahn kalokehkin komwi kalokolok suwed ehu ong mahn akan— ong sapwellimomwi oahs akan, ahs akan, kamel kan, kou kan, sihpw oh kuht kan.
I pahn katohrepeseng nein mehn Israel mahn akan oh nein mehn Isip kan, oh sohte nein mehn Israel mahn emen pahn mehla.
Ngehi KAUN-O, me kilelehdier me lakapw iei ahnsou me I pahn wiahda mepwukat.’”
Mandahn rahno KAUN-O ahpw ketin kapwaiahda dahme e mahsaniho. Eri, nein mehn Isip mahn ako koaros mehla, ahpw sohte emen nein mehn Israel ko mehla.
Parao eri keinemwe dahme wiawi, re ahpw padahkihong me sohte nein mehn Israel mahn emen me mehla. Ahpw nan kupwure keptakailahte oh sohte men mweidohng mehn Israel ko en patopatohla.
Kens kan
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Moses oh Aaron, “Kumwa ale ekei pehsen sang nan sidohp; Moses en sipedadawohng nan wehwe mwohn Parao.
Pehso ahpw pahn mwarakseli wasa koaros nan Isip duwehte pwelpar, oh e pahn kahrehiong aramas akan oh mahn akan ar pahn mpwoskihda, oh pahn sawapeseng wiahla kens.”
Ira eri ale pehs sang nan sidohp oh uh mwohn Parao; Moses eri sipedadalahng pehso nan wehwe, e ahpw kahrehda mpwos rehn aramas akan oh mahn akan me sawapeseng wiahla kens.
Sounakmanaman ko sohte kak pwarodo mwohn Moses, pwehki ar diren mpwosala duwehte mehn Isip teiko.
KAUN-O ahpw ketin kakeptakaila kupwur en Parao pwe en sohte men rong Moses oh Aaron, duwen me KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses.
Keteu Aihs Takai
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Moses, “Nin sohrahn ke pahn kohwei rehn Parao oh ndaiong me iet me KAUN-O, Koht en mehn Ipru kan, mahsanih, ‘Mweidala nei aramas akan pwe re en kolahng kaudokiong ie.
Met I pahn kihong pein komwi ei kalokolok kan koaros, oh ong sapwellimomwi lapalap akan, pwe komwi en mwahngih duwen eh sohte emen koht mie nin sampah pwon duwehte ngehi.
Ma I kamwakid pehiet pwe en kalokei komwi oh sapwellimomwi aramas akan, kumwail uhdahn pahn mwomwla douluhl.
Ahpw I mweidohng komwi en momour pwe I en kasalehiong komwi ei manaman, oh mwarei en kipehla wasa koaros nin sampah.
Eri, komwi ahpw pil lemeiongete nei aramas akan oh sohte mweidohng re en kohkohwei.
Eri, lakapwte I pahn kamwerehdi keteu aihs takai, soahng me saikinte wiawi nan Isip sang ni eh wiawihda.

Eri, komwi mahsanih pwe sapwellimomwi mahn akan oh mehkoaros me mihmi likin ihmw en kohlong nan ihmw. Keteu aihs takai pahn mwerediong pohn aramas koaros oh mahn koaros me sohte rukula, oh re pahn mehla.’”
Eri, ekei sapwellimen Parao lapalap ako ahpw masakada mahsenen KAUN-O, iei me re kihlong nan ihmw neirail lidu kan oh mahn akan.
A ekei sohte nsenohki mahseno, re ahpw sohte karukihala neirail lidu kan oh mahn akan.
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Moses, “Kauwadawohng pehmwen pahnlahng pwe keteu aihs takai en mwerediong pohn Isip, pohn aramas akan, mahn akan, oh dihpw en nansapw koaros.”
Moses ahpw kauwadalahng eh sokono pahnlahng, KAUN-O eri ketikihdi nansapwe oh keteu aihs takai, oh lioal lel nanpwel. KAUN-O eri ketin kamwerehdi
keteu aihs takai iangahki lioal me wie piripir. Iei met keieun melimel suwed me lel Isip sang ni eh wiahla wehin Isip.
Wasa koaros nan Isip melimel en aihs takaio lel mehkoaros me mihmi likin ihmw, aramas oh mahn koaros. E kemehla dihpw koaros en nansapw akan oh kauwehla tuhke koaros.
Ihte wasa me melimelo sohte lel ie, iei nan Kosen, wasa me mehn Israel ko koukousoan ie.
Parao eri malipehdo Moses oh Aaron, oh mahsanihong ira, “Met I dipadahr. KAUN-O me ketin pwung; ngehi oh nei aramas akan me sapwung.
Kumwa kapakapkin kiht rehn KAUN-O; pwe soangen nansapwe oh keteu aihs takai wet en tokedi. I inoukihda me I pahn mweidohng kumwail en kohkohwei, kumwail sohte pahn mihmi met.”

Moses eri patohwanohng, “Ni ahnsou me I pahn patohieila sang nan kahnimw wet, I pahn kauwadalahng rehn KAUN-O pehi kat. Nansapwe ahpw pahn tokedi, oh sohla pahn keteu aihs takai, pwe komwi en mwahngih me sampah uhdahn nin limen KAUN-O.
A met I ese me komwi oh sapwellimomwi lapalap akan saikinte lemmwikihla KAUN-O, Koht.”
Wahntuhke kan me adaneki plaks oh parli, re mengila, pwehki wahntuhke parli iower oh wahntuhke plaks ahpwtehn pwerla.
Ahpw wahn wihd sohte ohla, pwehki e saikinte lel ahnsoun ar mah.
Moses eri patopatohla sang rehn Parao patopatolahng likin kahnimwo. E ahpw kauwada peh ko pwe en kapakapohng KAUN-O. Eri, nansapwe oh keteu aihs takaio oh keteu ahpw tokedi.
Ni ahnsou me Parao mahsanihada me keteu, keteu aihs takai, oh nansapwe tokedier, e pil pwurehng dipada, iangahki sapwellime lapalap ako.
Nan eh keptakailahr e sohte kupwurki mehn Israel ko en kohkohla, duwen me KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses.
